value.message: Town of Oakville has Learn to Swim Parent and Tot / Preschool - their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am, and winter opens Dec 1 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville has 12-week preschool swim for ages 3-5, their site says. I could not get into their pages today for prices. I'll keep watching and text you when I do.
